svg.text: QUANTUM SYNTHESIZER · DOUBLE WELL · FIVE STILLS
Raise a wall in the middle, and every level splits into a beating pair. V(x) = ½x² + h·exp(−x²/2σ²), σ = 0.5; fₙ = 196 Hz × (Eₙ − E₀ + 1).
